name: Meeting History Backfill
status: reference only -- a one-time build run, never scheduled
description: Captures the calendar over a wide window in one bounded fetch. The same script over a 2-days-back / 14-ahead window is the live Meeting Capture delta; only the window differs.

steps.name: Fetch the window
steps.description: One calendarView fetch over the window, paged until complete.

steps.name: Ingest each event
steps.description: Series, occurrences and one-time meetings; attendees linked; related Threads linked. Idempotent: an occurrence's identity is series + start.

notes: Run it AFTER the email backfill, not beside it: both write People notes, and running them together lost ~60 events to contention the first time.
--limit defaults to 1000; a 90-day window on a busy calendar holds several hundred events.
